Definition: Urijah, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Uriah or Urijah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) is my light (flame)"; 1) Hittite husband of Bathsheba; 2) a priest who built king Ahaz' heathen altar; 3) a priest who rebuilt Jerusalem's wall; 4) a prophet slain by Jehoiakim
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
